value.basis: WAIS-IV longest backward digit span norms for adults 20–34 are around 5 (SD ~1.2–1.4); visual single-digit presentation with typed recall, a young educated sample, and the unproctored setting (occasional note-taking) nudge the mean slightly upward, while starting at length 3 with a 0 floor and a ceiling at 10 barely affect the distribution.
